name: two_taxes_round_then_sum
description: ROUND-THEN-SUM tax structure proof: base 1.110 with taxes 5% and 4.5%. Per-tax rounding: 55.5 -> 56 and 49.95 -> 50 under the core's deterministic midpoint law; total 106. Sum-then-round would give round(105.45) = 105 — one baisa LESS. The STRUCTURE (each tax line rounds itself, then sum) is the machine's own; the 55.5 midpoint resolution is the core's law (see tax_half_baisa_midpoint_law for the divergence class — on this particular input the device's noisy double happened to agree). Grand = 1110 + 106 = 1216.
